info.title: CAD A11y integration API
info.description: For tools that send models to CAD A11y. There are no routes yet: tools send models to /ingest until this API replaces it. Every error under /api/v1 is answered with the Error schema below.

code.description: Stable and machine-readable, named after the HTTP status.

message.description: For a person to read. The wording may change.
